"""Compare all 222 prior cases plus new fixtures and generated long-window cases.

Long-window cases run unlimited and retained modes with a 6000-bar seed.
The 600-plot metadata pressure fixture uses 64 bars in both modes; its purpose
is independent header coverage, not a long-window algorithm.
New matrix_ and bound_matrix_ fixtures use a 256-bar seed, matching matrix
workspace pressures. The 222 prior case seeds remain unchanged.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import uuid

DIRECTORY = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = DIRECTORY.parents[1]


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def write_json(path: Path, value: object) -> None:
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf8")


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--plan", type=Path, default=ROOT / ".local/state-performance-20261003/differential-after.json")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=120)
    parser.add_argument("--prepare-only", action="store_true", help="Report the canonical case/seed plan without executing probes")
    parser.add_argument("--extra", type=Path, action="append", default=[], help="Additional Pine source; both output retention modes are tested")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    old_plan = json.loads(args.plan.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    old_cases = [(row["source"].replace("\\", "/"), row["mode"], 257) for row in old_plan]
    if len(old_cases) != 222 or len(set(old_cases)) != 222:
        raise ValueError("Expected exactly the 222 unique previously selected cases")
    before = json.loads((DIRECTORY / "before-source-identity.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))["files"]
    new_fixtures = [path for path in sorted((ROOT / "tests/fixtures/runtime").glob("*.pine"))
                    if before.get(path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()) != digest(path)]
    explicit_extras = {path.resolve() for path in args.extra}
    extras = set(DIRECTORY.glob("*.pine")) | set(new_fixtures) | explicit_extras
    extra_sources = []
    for path in sorted(extras):
        source = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
        if any(source == case[0] for case in old_cases):
            # A modified old fixture also gets a long seed in addition to its
            # original selected seed. The identities of both are retained.
            if path not in new_fixtures and path not in explicit_extras:
                continue
        extra_sources.append(source)
    seed_overrides = {source: (64 if Path(source).name == "result-metadata-many.pine" else 256)
                      for source in extra_sources
                      if Path(source).name == "result-metadata-many.pine" or
                      Path(source).name.startswith(("bench-matrix-", "matrix_", "bound_matrix_"))}
    cases = old_cases + [(source, mode, seed_overrides.get(source, 6000))
                        for source in extra_sources for mode in ("unlimited", "retained")]
    if len(set(cases)) != len(cases):
        raise ValueError("Duplicate differential source/mode/seed cases")
    if args.prepare_only:
        print(json.dumps({"plannedCases": len(cases), "plannedProcesses": 2 * len(cases),
                          "priorCases": len(old_cases), "additionalSources": extra_sources,
                          "additionalSeedBars": 6000, "additionalSeedOverrides": seed_overrides,
                          "probesExecuted": False}, ensure_ascii=False))
        return
    identities = {}
    for tag in ("before", "after"):
        binary = DIRECTORY / f"differential-{tag}.exe"
        linked = DIRECTORY / f"identity-differential-{tag}.json"
        link = json.loads(linked.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
        if link["executableSha256"] != digest(binary) or link["sourceSha256"] != digest(DIRECTORY / "differential.rs"):
            raise RuntimeError(f"Differential link identity mismatch: {tag}")
        identities[tag] = {"binary": str(binary), "binarySha256": digest(binary), "linkReceipt": link,
                           "linkReceiptSha256": digest(linked)}
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S.%fZ") + "-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
    out = DIRECTORY / "differential-receipts" / stamp
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    rows = []
    receipt = {"status": "running", "plan": str(args.plan), "planSha256": digest(args.plan),
               "probeSourceSha256": digest(DIRECTORY / "differential.rs"), "identities": identities,
               "plannedCases": len(cases), "priorCases": 222, "additionalSources": extra_sources,
               "additionalSeedBars": 6000, "additionalSeedOverrides": seed_overrides, "records": rows}
    try:
        for index, (source, mode, seed_count) in enumerate(cases):
            path = ROOT / Path(source.replace("\\", "/"))
            row = {"source": source, "mode": mode, "seedBars": seed_count,
                   "sourceSha256": digest(path), "results": {}}
            rows.append(row)
            snapshots = {}
            for tag in ("before", "after"):
                command = [identities[tag]["binary"], str(path), mode, str(seed_count)]
                try:
                    process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, timeout=args.timeout)
                    raw, errors, code = process.stdout, process.stderr, process.returncode
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
                    raw, errors, code = error.stdout or b"", error.stderr or b"", None
                stem = f"{index:03d}-{tag}"
                (out / f"{stem}.stdout").write_bytes(raw)
                (out / f"{stem}.stderr").write_bytes(errors)
                result = {"command": command, "returncode": code, "stdoutReceipt": f"{stem}.stdout",
                          "stderrReceipt": f"{stem}.stderr", "stdoutSha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                          "stderrSha256": hashlib.sha256(errors).hexdigest()}
                row["results"][tag] = result
                if code != 0:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"Differential process failed: {index}/{tag}, exit={code}")
                lines = raw.splitlines()
                decoded = [json.loads(line) for line in lines]
                if len(lines) != 33 or any(not isinstance(record, dict) or set(record) != {"snapshot", "changes"} or
                                          not isinstance(record["snapshot"], dict) for record in decoded):
                    raise ValueError(f"Expected 33 full snapshot/change records: {index}/{tag}")
                if decoded[0]["changes"] is not None or any(not isinstance(record["changes"], dict) for record in decoded[1:]):
                    raise ValueError(f"Expected 32 complete delta records: {index}/{tag}")
                snapshots[tag] = lines
                result["snapshots"] = [hashlib.sha256(line).hexdigest() for line in lines]
                write_json(out / "progress.json", receipt)
            row["equal"] = snapshots["before"] == snapshots["after"]
            if not row["equal"]:
                row["differentSnapshotIndices"] = [i for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(snapshots["before"], snapshots["after"])) if a != b]
                print("MISMATCH", source, mode, row["differentSnapshotIndices"], flush=True)
            if digest(path) != row["sourceSha256"]:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Fixture changed during comparison: {path}")
            write_json(out / "progress.json", receipt)
            if (index + 1) % 25 == 0:
                print(f"Compared {index + 1}/{len(cases)} cases", flush=True)
        for tag, entry in identities.items():
            if digest(Path(entry["binary"])) != entry["binarySha256"]:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Differential binary changed: {tag}")
        if digest(args.plan) != receipt["planSha256"] or digest(DIRECTORY / "differential.rs") != receipt["probeSourceSha256"]:
            raise RuntimeError("Differential plan or source changed during comparison")
        failures = [row for row in rows if not row["equal"]]
        receipt.update(status="passed" if not failures else "failed", cases=len(rows),
                       passed=len(rows) - len(failures), failures=failures,
                       equalChanges=32 * sum(1 for row in rows if row["equal"]),
                       equalSnapshots=sum(len(row["results"]["after"]["snapshots"]) for row in rows if row["equal"]))
        write_json(out / "summary.json", receipt)
        write_json(DIRECTORY / "differential-results.json", receipt)
        if failures:
            raise RuntimeError(f"{len(failures)} differential cases differ; all cases and receipts retained")
        print(f"PASS {len(rows)}/{len(cases)} cases; {receipt['equalSnapshots']} exact snapshots; {out / 'summary.json'}", flush=True)
    except BaseException as error:
        receipt.update(status="failed", error=str(error), completedCases=len(rows))
        write_json(out / "failure.json", receipt)
        write_json(out / "progress.json", receipt)
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Validate public matrix recovery and explicit NA against independent answers."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import uuid

DIRECTORY = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = DIRECTORY.parents[1]
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--tag', choices=['before', 'after', 'both'], default='both')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    plan_path = DIRECTORY / 'correctness-plan.json'
    plan = json.loads(plan_path.read_text(encoding='utf8'))
    tags = ['before', 'after'] if args.tag == 'both' else [args.tag]
    identities = {}
    for tag in tags:
        binary = DIRECTORY / f'differential-{tag}.exe'
        link_path = DIRECTORY / f'identity-differential-{tag}.json'
        link = json.loads(link_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
        assert sha(binary) == link['executableSha256']
        assert sha(DIRECTORY / 'differential.rs') == link['sourceSha256']
        identities[tag] = {'binary': str(binary), 'binarySha256': sha(binary),
                           'linkReceipt': link, 'linkReceiptSha256': sha(link_path)}
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S.%fZ') + '-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
    out = DIRECTORY / 'correctness-receipts' / stamp
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    receipt = {'status': 'running', 'tag': args.tag, 'runnerSha256': sha(Path(__file__)),
               'planSha256': sha(plan_path), 'plan': plan, 'identities': identities, 'records': []}
    try:
        for case in plan:
            source = DIRECTORY / 'correctness' / case['source']
            for mode in ['unlimited', 'retained']:
                for tag in tags:
                    command = [identities[tag]['binary'], str(source), mode, '4']
                    process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, timeout=120)
                    stem = f"{source.stem}-{mode}-{tag}"
                    (out / f'{stem}.stdout').write_bytes(process.stdout)
                    (out / f'{stem}.stderr').write_bytes(process.stderr)
                    row = {'case': source.name, 'mode': mode, 'tag': tag, 'command': command,
                           'sourceSha256': sha(source), 'returncode': process.returncode,
                           'stdoutReceipt': f'{stem}.stdout', 'stderrReceipt': f'{stem}.stderr',
                           'stdoutSha256': hashlib.sha256(process.stdout).hexdigest(),
                           'stderrSha256': hashlib.sha256(process.stderr).hexdigest()}
                    receipt['records'].append(row)
                    assert process.returncode == 0, row
                    records = [json.loads(line) for line in process.stdout.splitlines()]
                    assert len(records) == 33
                    expected = case[tag]
                    checked = 0
                    for record in records:
                        plots = {plot['title']: plot['values'] for plot in record['snapshot']['plots']}
                        assert set(plots) == set(expected), (row, plots.keys(), expected.keys())
                        for title, target in expected.items():
                            assert plots[title]
                            for actual in plots[title]:
                                if target is None:
                                    assert actual is None, (row, title, actual)
                                else:
                                    assert actual is not None and math.isfinite(actual), (row, title, actual)
                                    tolerance = case.get('absoluteTolerance', {}).get(title, 0.0)
                                    relative_tolerance = case.get('relativeTolerance', 1e-13)
                                    assert math.isclose(actual, target, rel_tol=relative_tolerance, abs_tol=tolerance), (row, title, actual, target)
                                checked += 1
                    row.update(status='passed', snapshots=33, deltas=32, checkedValues=checked,
                               expectedPlotValues=expected)
        for entry in identities.values():
            assert sha(Path(entry['binary'])) == entry['binarySha256']
        assert sha(plan_path) == receipt['planSha256']
        receipt.update(status='passed', publicCases=2 * len(plan), processes=len(receipt['records']),
                       snapshotsPerVersion=66 * len(plan), deltasPerVersion=64 * len(plan))
    except BaseException as error:
        receipt.update(status='failed', error=repr(error))
        raise
    finally:
        (out / 'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2), encoding='utf8')
        (DIRECTORY / f'matrix-correctness-{args.tag}-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2), encoding='utf8')
    print('PASS', receipt['publicCases'], 'public matrix cases, versions', tags, out / 'summary.json', flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

     'purpose': 'Characteristic polynomial (H-lambda)^2-H^2/2 has two distinct real roots H*(1 +/- sqrt(1/2))'},

               'complex_eigenvalues_is_na': 1, 'complex_eigenvectors_is_na': 1},

def input_identity():

        if sha(d / 'correctness' / source) != expected:
            raise RuntimeError(f'Eigen input changed: {source}')
    original = d / 'correctness/qr-column-norm-overflow.pine'
    duplicate = d / 'correctness/eigen-qr-column-norm-overflow.pine'

    return {'path': str(identity_path), 'sha256': sha(identity_path), 'identity': identity,
            'duplicate': {'source': duplicate.name, 'sha256': sha(duplicate),
                          'coveredBy': original.name, 'coveredBySha256': sha(original)}}


def before_identity():
    binary = d / 'differential-before.exe'
    link_path = d / 'identity-differential-before.json'

        raise RuntimeError('Frozen before differential binary/source does not match its link receipt')
    return {'binary': str(binary), 'binarySha256': sha(binary), 'linkReceipt': str(link_path),
            'linkReceiptSha256': sha(link_path), 'link': link}

    records = [json.loads(line) for line in raw.splitlines()]
    if len(records) != 33:
        raise ValueError('Expected 33 before snapshot/change records')
    if records[0]['changes'] is not None or any(not isinstance(record['changes'], dict) for record in records[1:]):
        raise ValueError('Expected initial snapshot and 32 complete before deltas')

    for record in records:
        plots = {plot['title']: plot['values'] for plot in record['snapshot']['plots']}
        if set(plots) != set(expected_titles):
            raise ValueError(f'Unexpected plot titles: {list(plots)}')
        for title, values in plots.items():
            if not values:
                raise ValueError(f'Empty plot: {title}')
            for value in values:
                if value is not None and (isinstance(value, bool) or
                                          not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(value)):
                    raise ValueError(f'Invalid observed before plot: {title}={value}')
                if title in result and value != result[title]:
                    raise ValueError(f'Static before fixture changed its plot value: {title}')
                result[title] = value
    return result

    out = d / 'correctness-plan-receipts' / stamp

    receipt = {'status': 'running', 'mode': 'unlimited', 'seedBars': 4,
               'purpose': 'Observe the frozen before implementation; after answers are independently derived',
               'runnerSha256': sha(Path(__file__)), 'identity': identity,
               'inputIdentity': inputs, 'records': []}
    initial = d / 'matrix-correctness-before-results.json'
    if initial.exists():
        backup = out / 'initial-matrix-correctness-before-results.json'
        backup.write_bytes(initial.read_bytes())
        receipt['preservedInitialBeforeSummary'] = {'source': str(initial), 'receipt': str(backup),
                                                  'sha256': sha(backup)}
    try:
        for case in new_cases:
            source = d / 'correctness' / case['source']
            command = [identity['binary'], str(source), 'unlimited', '4']
            try:
                process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, capture_output=True, timeout=120)
                raw, errors, code = process.stdout, process.stderr, process.returncode
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
                raw, errors, code = error.stdout or b'', error.stderr or b'', None
            stem = source.stem + '-before-discovery'
            stdout, stderr, exit_path = (out / (stem + suffix) for suffix in ('.stdout', '.stderr', '.exit.json'))
            stdout.write_bytes(raw)
            stderr.write_bytes(errors)
            save(exit_path, {'command': command, 'returncode': code})
            row = {'source': source.name, 'sourceSha256': sha(source), 'command': command,
                   'returncode': code, 'stdoutReceipt': str(stdout), 'stderrReceipt': str(stderr),
                   'exitReceipt': str(exit_path), 'stdoutSha256': sha(stdout),
                   'stderrSha256': sha(stderr), 'exitSha256': sha(exit_path)}
            receipt['records'].append(row)
            if code != 0:
                raise RuntimeError(f'Before eigen observation failed: {source.name}, exit={code}')
            row['before'] = constant_plot_values(raw, case['after'])
        if before_identity() != identity or input_identity() != inputs:
            raise RuntimeError('Before binary/link/source/input identity changed during observation')
        receipt.update(status='passed', processes=len(receipt['records']))
    except BaseException as error:
        receipt.update(status='failed', error=repr(error))
        raise
    finally:
        save(out / 'summary.json', receipt)
    observation_path = d / 'eigen-before-observations.json'
    save(observation_path, {'summary': str(out / 'summary.json'), 'summarySha256': sha(out / 'summary.json')})
    return receipt, observation_path


def load_before(inputs):
    observation_path = d / 'eigen-before-observations.json'
    locator = json.loads(observation_path.read_text(encoding='utf8'))
    summary = Path(locator['summary'])
    if sha(summary) != locator['summarySha256']:
        raise RuntimeError('Observed before summary SHA mismatch')
    receipt = json.loads(summary.read_text(encoding='utf8'))
    if receipt['status'] != 'passed' or receipt['identity'] != before_identity() or receipt['inputIdentity'] != inputs:
        raise RuntimeError('Observed before identities do not match the current frozen baseline/inputs')
    if receipt['processes'] != len(new_cases):
        raise RuntimeError('Incomplete before discovery process count')
    for row in receipt['records']:
        if sha(d / 'correctness' / row['source']) != row['sourceSha256'] or row['returncode'] != 0:
            raise RuntimeError('Observed before source/exit changed')
        for kind in ('stdout', 'stderr', 'exit'):
            if sha(Path(row[kind + 'Receipt'])) != row[kind + 'Sha256']:
                raise RuntimeError(f'Observed before {kind} SHA mismatch')
    return receipt, observation_path


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--observe-before', action='store_true', help='Capture five new immutable before observations in a unique receipt directory')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    inputs = input_identity()
    observed, observation_path = capture_before(inputs) if args.observe_before else load_before(inputs)
    observations = {row['source']: row for row in observed['records']}
    for case in new_cases:
        row = observations[case['source']]
        rows.append(dict(case, before=row['before'], beforeObservation={
            'locator': str(observation_path), 'locatorSha256': sha(observation_path),
            'stdoutReceipt': row['stdoutReceipt'], 'stdoutSha256': row['stdoutSha256'],
            'stderrReceipt': row['stderrReceipt'], 'stderrSha256': row['stderrSha256'],
            'exitReceipt': row['exitReceipt'], 'exitSha256': row['exitSha256']}))
    if len(rows) != 13 or len({row['source'] for row in rows}) != 13:
        raise RuntimeError('Expected thirteen independent correctness sources after QR deduplication')
    save(d / 'correctness-plan.json', rows)
    print('Prepared', len(rows), 'matrix sources /', 2 * len(rows), 'public cases per version; five raw before observations preserved')

"""Independent offline audit of the final frozen numeric/dispatch evidence.

Run only after all probes and gates finish. This script never imports a runner,
compiles code, or executes a probe. Raw receipts, current artifacts, and source
archives are read directly; reported statistics and plot answers are rechecked.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
from fractions import Fraction
from itertools import zip_longest
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import re
import statistics
import subprocess
import tarfile
import traceback
import uuid

DIRECTORY = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = DIRECTORY.parents[1]
TAGS = ("before", "after")
PROBES = {"heap": "heap_probe.rs", "dispatch": "dispatch_probe.rs",
          "result": "result_probe.rs", "differential": "differential.rs"}


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def unique_object(pairs):
    result = {}
    for name, value in pairs:
        require(name not in result, f"Duplicate JSON key: {name}")
        result[name] = value
    return result


def reject_constant(value):
    raise ValueError(f"Non-finite JSON number: {value}")


def decode(raw):
    return json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=unique_object, parse_constant=reject_constant)


def read(path):
    return decode(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))


def numeric(value):
    return isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool)


def display(path):
    try:
        return path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
    except ValueError:
        return str(path)


def resolved(value):
    path = Path(str(value).replace("\\", "/"))
    return path if path.is_absolute() else ROOT / path


class Audit:
    def __init__(self):
        self.hashes = {}
        self.artifacts = {}
        self.output = {"schemaVersion": 1, "status": "running",
                       "utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                       "auditRunId": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S.%fZ") + "-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8],
                       "scope": "Offline independent raw-output, statistical, SHA, link, frozen-source and completed-gate audit; no probe execution or compilation",
                       "processCounts": {}, "receiptFileCounts": {}, "matchedRuns": {},
                       "artifactChecks": [], "failures": []}

    def sha(self, path):
        path = path.resolve()
        if path not in self.hashes:
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open("rb") as stream:
                for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
                    digest.update(block)
            self.hashes[path] = digest.hexdigest()
        return self.hashes[path]

    def artifact(self, group, path, expected=None):
        path = path.resolve()
        actual = self.sha(path)
        if expected is not None:
            require(isinstance(expected, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", expected),
                    f"Invalid declared SHA: {display(path)}")
            require(actual == expected, f"SHA mismatch: {group}: {display(path)}")
        key = (group, path)
        item = {"group": group, "path": display(path), "sha256": actual,
                "bytes": path.stat().st_size, "equal": True}
        if expected is not None:
            item["declaredSha256"] = expected
        self.artifacts[key] = item
        return actual

    def matched_run(self, group, filename):
        path = DIRECTORY / filename
        expected = self.artifact("final result summary", path)
        data = read(path)
        require(data["status"] == "passed", f"Unfinished/failed summary: {filename}")
        candidates = [path for path in (DIRECTORY / f"{group}-receipts").glob("*/summary.json")
                      if self.sha(path) == expected]
        require(len(candidates) == 1, f"Expected one matching immutable run: {filename}: {candidates}")
        self.artifact(f"{group} archived summary", candidates[0], expected)
        self.output["matchedRuns"][group] = display(candidates[0].parent)
        return data, candidates[0].parent

    def execution(self, group, directory, row):
        require(row["returncode"] == 0, f"Nonzero execution: {group}: {row}")
        require("timeout" not in row, f"Timed out execution: {row}")
        paths = []
        for kind in ("stdout", "stderr"):
            name = row[f"{kind}Receipt"]
            require(Path(name).name == name, f"Receipt is not a local basename: {name}")
            path = directory / name
            self.artifact(f"{group} {kind}", path, row[f"{kind}Sha256"])
            self.output["receiptFileCounts"][f"{group}_{kind}"] = self.output["receiptFileCounts"].get(f"{group}_{kind}", 0) + 1
            paths.append(path)
        require(paths[1].stat().st_size == 0, f"Unexpected probe stderr: {display(paths[1])}")
        return paths[0]

    def freeze(self):
        manifests = {}
        for tag, count, archive_name in (("before", 6299, "before-source.tar"),
                                         ("after", 6302, "source.tar")):
            path = DIRECTORY / f"{tag}-source-identity.json"
            self.artifact("source manifest", path)
            manifest = read(path)
            manifests[tag] = manifest
            require(len(manifest["files"]) == count, f"Frozen {tag} source count differs")
            require(manifest["base_commit"] == "e76cf5f3213639911fac4fa913bd4541831ee62c", f"Wrong baseline commit: {tag}")
            archive = DIRECTORY / archive_name
            self.artifact("source archive", archive)
            members = {}
            with tarfile.open(archive, "r") as stream:
                for member in stream:
                    require(member.isfile() and member.name not in members, f"Invalid/duplicate tar member: {member.name}")
                    file = stream.extractfile(member)
                    digest = hashlib.sha256()
                    for block in iter(lambda: file.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
                        digest.update(block)
                    members[member.name] = digest.hexdigest()
            require(members == manifest["files"], f"Frozen {tag} tar differs from source manifest")
        self.artifact("active source manifest", DIRECTORY / "source-identity.json")
        require(read(DIRECTORY / "source-identity.json") == manifests["after"], "Active source manifest differs from final after freeze")
        for name, expected in manifests["after"]["files"].items():
            self.artifact("frozen current source", ROOT / name, expected)
        names = subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-files", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "-z"], cwd=ROOT).decode("utf8").split("\0")
        current = {name for name in names if name and (ROOT / name).is_file()}
        require(current == set(manifests["after"]["files"]), "Current nonignored source file set differs from frozen 6302")
        self.artifact("baseline binary manifest", DIRECTORY / "before-binary-identity.json")
        baseline = read(DIRECTORY / "before-binary-identity.json")
        require(len(baseline) == 501, "Baseline binary artifact count differs from 501")
        require({path.relative_to(DIRECTORY / "baseline").as_posix() for path in (DIRECTORY / "baseline").rglob("*") if path.is_file()} == set(baseline), "Baseline binary file set differs")
        for name, expected in baseline.items():
            self.artifact("frozen baseline release artifact", DIRECTORY / "baseline" / name, expected)
        self.output["sourceFreeze"] = {"beforeFiles": 6299, "afterFiles": 6302,
                                      "baselineArtifacts": 501, "archivesMatchManifests": True,
                                      "currentSourceAndFileSetMatch": True}
        return manifests, baseline

    def links(self, baseline):
        links = {}
        for group, source in PROBES.items():
            for tag in TAGS:
                path = DIRECTORY / f"identity-{group}-{tag}.json"
                self.artifact("probe link receipt", path)
                link = read(path)
                require(link["tag"] == tag and link["probe"] == group, f"Wrong probe identity: {path}")
                self.artifact("current probe executable", DIRECTORY / f"{group}-{tag}.exe", link["executableSha256"])
                self.artifact("current probe source", DIRECTORY / source, link["sourceSha256"])
                require(len(link["libraryHashes"]) == 4, f"Unexpected linked library count: {path}")
                for library, expected in link["libraryHashes"].items():
                    if tag == "before":
                        normalized = library.replace("\\", "/")
                        require("target/release/" in normalized, f"Inherited before library path unexpected: {library}")
                        name = normalized.split("target/release/", 1)[1]
                        require(baseline[name] == expected, f"Before linked library differs from frozen baseline: {library}")
                    else:
                        self.artifact("current linked release library", resolved(library), expected)
                arguments = link["compilerArguments"]
                require("--edition=2024" in arguments and "-O" in arguments and "lto=thin" in arguments and "codegen-units=1" in arguments, f"Probe compiler arguments differ: {path}")
                if group in ("result", "differential"):
                    require("borrowed_result" in arguments, f"Borrowed output path absent: {group}/{tag}")
                if tag == "before":
                    origin = resolved(link["baselineOrigin"])
                    self.artifact("baseline origin link receipt", origin, link["baselineOriginSha256"])
                    original = read(origin)
                    require(original["tag"] == "after" and original["probe"] == group, f"Wrong baseline origin: {origin}")
                    for key in ("executableSha256", "sourceSha256", "libraryHashes", "compilerArguments", "rustc"):
                        require(original[key] == link[key], f"Inherited baseline origin changed: {group}/{key}")
                    self.artifact("baseline origin executable", origin.parent / f"{group}-after.exe", original["executableSha256"])
                    self.artifact("baseline origin probe source", origin.parent / source, original["sourceSha256"])
                else:
                    self.artifact("probe link log", DIRECTORY / f"link-{group}-{tag}.log")
                links[group, tag] = link
        self.output["probeLinks"] = {f"{group}-{tag}": {"linkSha256": self.sha(DIRECTORY / f"identity-{group}-{tag}.json"), "executableSha256": value["executableSha256"], "sourceSha256": value["sourceSha256"]} for (group, tag), value in links.items()}
        return links

    def identity_entry(self, group, tag, entry, links):
        current = links[group, tag]
        path = DIRECTORY / f"identity-{group}-{tag}.json"

        require(parsed["bars"] == bars and parsed["resultBytes"] == len(raw) and len(result["plots"]) == 1 and len(result["plots"][0]["values"]) == bars, "Dispatch lost bars/bytes/plot values")
        check_metrics(parsed)

    lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf8").splitlines()

    records = [decode(line) for line in lines]
    require(all(isinstance(record, dict) for record in records), f"Benchmark JSONL record is not object: {path}")

        require(len(records) == 1 and records[0]["bars"] == bars and records[0]["mode"] == mode, f"Heap stdout shape differs: {path}")
